control_point: Credit derivatives positions are adjusted following an ISDA Credit Derivatives Determinations Committee decision, including succession-event treatment, credit-event application and auction settlement; the control point is the use of the published DC outcome to update reference-entity and obligation attributes rather than firm-only interpretation.

citations.source_name: ISDA, Credit Derivatives Determinations Committees Rules

consequence_anchor.public_source: ISDA DC Rules, auction settlement methodology and CFTC/SEC record-keeping for swap portfolios
consequence_anchor.magnitude_band: trade remediation, auction settlement mismatch and regulatory record-keeping penalties; magnitude scales with position size and number of affected trades

commonality_rationale: All market participants holding standardized credit derivatives rely on the same ISDA DC determinations for credit events and succession events; failure to apply the published outcome produces common, cross-firm misalignment.
